text: Create a new page and insert a red star.

source.original: Insert a star and make its width and height 6.5cm.

text: Insert a rectangle in same color of content.

source.original: Diagram for cctv

source.original: Show diagram of SAP ATP flow

source.original: give me a flow chart of ARIMA algorithm

source.original: draw a Venn diagram show the similarities and differences of the three communication models / Linear Model / Interactive / Transactional

source.original: draw me a data flow diagram about coca-cola's production and profits and materials used

needs: diagram topic/content ("about coca-cola's production and profits and materials used"): no content key for generated diagrams

source.original: draw a model of graph database

text: Insert a triangle to the page. Insert a rectangle to the page. Make the rectangle on the right side of the rectangle.

source.original: Insert a triangle to the slide. Insert a rectangle to the slide. Make the rectangle on the right side of the rectangle. ## 1, rectangle, triangle, right

text: Insert a rectangle, ohno, a triangle into the page

source.original: Generate a flowchart using valid mermaid.js syntax that shows the process for making a cup of tea. Then explain the process.

source.original: Create an algorithm and a flowchart that will output for g.c.d.

text: Create a flow chart with node inside a node

source.original: Create a flow chart with node inside a node

source.original: make a flowchart: Start, Check stock, Ship and Done

source.original: draw a tree with Animals at the top

text: move Publish to around the middle

source.original: move Publish to around the middle

source.original: move Review a bit to the left

text: put Publish lower

source.original: put Publish lower

needs: node.direction=down (relative move without anchor): no diagram key; drawing has drawn.direction

text: move start and done higher

source.original: move start and done higher

source.original: How to make all nodes same size in TikZ?

source.original: Trapezia in process flow chart (Tikz) are not equal in width, how do I make them the same size?

text: create a horizontal flow chart with five sequential boxes

source.original: How to I create a horizontal flow chart in tikz with five sequential images in Tikz?

text: create a mindmap that has two connected roots

source.original: How do I create a Tikz mindmap that has two connected roots?

needs: mind map with two roots: no key for the number of root nodes of a generated tree/mind map

text: Tree: depth of 4 nodes

text: Flow chart for this scenario in zuora When a customer has an overdue payment and needs to be reminded about it through automated emails on 7th,14th, 17, 20th, 22nd, 25th & 29th days

source.original: Flow chart for this scenario in zuora When a customer has an overdue payment and needs to be reminded about it through automated emails on 7th,14th, 17, 20th, 22nd, 25th & 29th days

text: make a bunch of random shapes

source.original: make a bunch of random shapes

source.original: draw a diagram with 5 to 10 nodes

source.original: Copy the pie chart to the next slide.

source.original: Flow chart with constant distance between modules in smartdiagram package
